site_name: Gezira State (Wad Medani, Elmanagil, Wad Elhadad, Rufaa)
temporal_notes: Six collection rounds conducted between October 2008 and January 2011 across two seasons per year (wet season Oct-Nov, dry season Jan).
source_text: Four sentinel sites were identified for biannual resistance monitoring... Anopheles mosquitoes were collected between October 2008 and January 2011... Mosquitoes were collected as larvae... and reared to the adult stage... Identification to species level revealed only the presence of An. arabiensis from all four sentinel sites.
